user.title: Set up OpenPlate
user.description: OpenPlate encrypts its own connection. Use a local Home Assistant address such as http://homeassistant.local:8123 without setting up HTTPS certificates. The address is normally detected automatically. If this field appears, confirm or correct it to display the QR code.

data_description.home_assistant_url: Address of your HA installation, not the iPhone. Local HTTP or HTTPS, without a page path such as /config/integrations.

pairing_qr.title: Pair the iPhone
pairing_qr.description: Open OpenPlate on the iPhone and scan this code with the pairing button. Then select Submit here. This single-use code expires after at most 10 minutes. Pairing, configuration and plate events are encrypted even over local HTTP. Keep the QR code private.

error.invalid_ha_url: Enter a local HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.https_required: The separate recognition server requires a complete HTTPS address.
error.api_key_required: Enter the recognition server API key.

abort.pairing_expired: Pairing is no longer available. Generate a new QR code.

init.title: Manage OpenPlate
init.description: Choose what you want to configure.

plates.title: Registered plates
plates.description: Add, rename or remove plates. Changes apply after submitting.

data_description.plates: One plate per line as PLATE=Display name. Spaces and hyphens are normalized.

pairing.title: Pair the iPhone
pairing.description: Enter the local HTTP or HTTPS address of Home Assistant to display the encrypted pairing code. Pairing needs no iPhone IP, API key or certificates.

data_description.home_assistant_url: Address of your HA installation, not the iPhone. Local HTTP or HTTPS, without a page path such as /config/integrations.

pairing_qr.title: Pair the iPhone
pairing_qr.description: Open OpenPlate on the iPhone and scan this code with the pairing button. Then select Submit here. This single-use code expires after at most 10 minutes. Pairing, configuration and plate events are encrypted even over local HTTP. Keep the QR code private.

connection.title: Home Assistant address
connection.description: Change this address if the QR points to an incorrect name or unreachable IP. Local HTTP is allowed because OpenPlate encrypts messages itself. Generate a new code under Pair an iPhone afterwards if needed.

data_description.home_assistant_url: Address of your HA installation, not the iPhone. Local HTTP or HTTPS, without a page path such as /config/integrations.

recognition.title: Configure recognition server
recognition.description: Configure the running recognition server separately from pairing. The open app retrieves changes automatically within about 15 seconds. Camera frames to the separate recognition server still require HTTPS. This integration does not start that server itself.

data_description.recognition_url: Local OpenPlate server with a TLS certificate trusted by the iPhone.
data_description.recognition_api_key: API key configured on the recognition server.
data_description.capture_interval: How often the iPhone sends a camera frame for recognition.

data_description.absence_timeout: How long a registered plate remains recently seen.
